title: Carrying Feature Ablations Across Sparse Autoencoder Seeds
abstract: arXiv:2611.34637v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A vision encoder turns an image into one vector per patch, refined layer by layer. A sparse autoencoder (SAE) writes each vector of one layer as a sum of learned directions, most with a coefficient of zero. Researchers call each direction a feature and edit the encoder by removing one feature. An SAE trained from another random seed learns different features. Earlier work matches the two SAEs' features one to one by how closely their directions agree. Matched features can point alike yet respond to different image parts, so removing them may change the encoder differently. We remove a feature and, separately, its match, then compare the changes in the encoder's output on the same held out images. When the second change nearly reproduces the first, we say the removal carries across seeds. A setting fixes a DINOv2 or SigLIP layer and its SAE feature count. At our tolerance, the removal carries for 12% to 70% of matched pairs across three

translated_title: 跨稀疏自编码器随机种子移植特征消融
translated_abstract: 视觉编码器将图像转换为每个图像块一个向量，并逐层精炼。稀疏自编码器（SAE）将某一层的每个向量表示为若干学习到的方向之和，其中大多数方向的系数为零。研究人员将每个方向称为一个特征，并通过移除某个特征来编辑编码器。而使用另一个随机种子训练的SAE会学习到不同的特征。先前的工作根据方向的一致程度将两个SAE的特征进行一对一匹配。然而匹配的特征可能方向相似，却对图像的不同部分产生响应，因此移除它们可能对编码器产生不同的改变。我们移除一个特征，并单独移除其匹配特征，然后在相同的留出图像上比较编码器输出的变化。当第二种变化几乎复现第一种变化时，我们称该移除操作可以跨种子移植。实验设置固定DINOv2或SigLIP的某一层及其SAE特征数量。在我们的容差范围内，移除操作在三个（种子间的）12%至70%的匹配特征对上能够移植。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种方法：通过分别在两个SAE中移除匹配特征并比较编码器输出的变化，来判断特征消融能否跨随机种子移植，发现在其容差下12%至70%的匹配特征对能够成功跨种子移植。
en_tdlr: This paper tests whether feature ablations carry across sparse autoencoder seeds by comparing encoder output changes when removing matched features, finding that 12% to 70% of matched pairs carry across seeds at their tolerance.
